build_maskrcnn_resnest50: build a mask r-cnn model with resnest50 backbone for instance segmentation on coco dataset
configure_syncbn_backbone: configure syncbn normalization for resnest backbone and shared bbox head in mask r-cnn
setup_train_pipeline: setup multi-scale training pipeline with random resize, random flip, and annotation loading for detection
customize_data_preprocessor: customize image normalization with resnest mean std values and bgr to rgb conversion
extend_maskrcnn_config: extend mask r-cnn r50 base config with resnest50 pretrained checkpoint and shared conv bbox head
